/** CommonCodeGroupMapper.searchCommonCodeGroups */ SELECT com_code_group_cd, com_code_group_name FROM t_common_code_group
AND com_code_group_cd like #{comCodeGroupCd} || '%'
AND com_code_group_name like #{comCodeGroupName} || '%'
ORDER BY com_code_group_cd ASC
